subject: what to fund in cycle 2

attempts.text: @Priority Six workflows cover items 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 9 and 10. Items 5 and 8 are left out for budget. Check texts carry no digits, targets are plain ids or classes, and tap-targets is dropped. Parts total 85 at the rate card against 60 remaining, so I expect a counter. Trade-off: the shell carries the nav, hero and N8, and sponsors go last.

@Adaptation COUNTER at exactly 60 of 60. Your set prices 85, so I cut 25: (1) shell loses the form part (-15), since it builds no form and the register workflow already owns item 4; touch-sized inputs stay as a styling constraint. (2) Venue and contact merge into one page_section (-10); the section keeps both a map link and a WhatsApp link, and the contact block gets id contact so nav links resolve. Sponsors (item 5) and the extra styling for item 8 stay unfunded. Trade-off: zero reserve, so any Audit fix (8 each) will need Identity to approve more budget. Merged item 6 and 7 cost 5 per item below the rate-card minimum; I accept that because both are small static blocks.

constraints: Use only charter times and event names
Day buttons must not cause horizontal overflow
No inline JS errors on load

how.steps: Add section id schedule with a heading, three day buttons of class j2-btn with class j2-daytab, and three panels of class j2-day, one per day, each listing its events with times in the form 10am-1pm. Day 1 shows Code Sprint 10am-1pm, Line Follower 2pm-5pm, AI in Daily Life 5:30pm-6:30pm. Day 2 shows Bug Hunt 11am-1pm, Poster Jam 2pm-4pm. Day 3 shows Drone Dash 10am-1pm, UI Duel 2pm-5pm, Startup Stories 5:30pm-6:30pm. Small script switches the visible panel and shows Day 1 first.

how.steps: Create one style block with id j2-style: dark base with bold accent colours, big headings, responsive grid, buttons class j2-btn, cards class j2-card, box-sizing border-box, no fixed widths over the viewport, touch-sized form inputs. Create section id hero with the h1 Spark 2026, Northfield College of Engineering, Pune, 14 to 16 February 2027, and one main button of class j2-btn linking to #register. Add a footer.
